article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Kam Burton’s 36 points led La Salle over Coppin State 88-61 on Wednesday. Burton had a big night from beyond the arc for the Explorers (2-3), as he connected on 11 of his 16 3-point attempts. Rob Dockery scored 11 points while shooting 2 for 8 (2 for 7 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line, and added seven rebounds. Devin Booker had 10 points and shot 3 of 13 from the field, including 1 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 3 from the line. Brendan Johnson led the Eagles (1-5) in scoring, finishing with 21 points. Baasil Saunders added 17 points for Coppin State. Camaren Sparrrow finished with six points. La Salle took the lead with 19:22 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Burton led their team in scoring with 18 points in the first half to help put them up 51-19 at the break. Burton scored 18 points in the second half to help lead the way as La Salle went on to secure a victory, despite being outscored by Coppin State in the second half by a five-point margin. Up next Both teams play again on Saturday. La Salle hosts Pennsylvania and Coppin State travels to play Georgetown. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
